module_summary: Synchronous FIFO: 8-entry register array with write/read pointers and occupancy counter, valid/ready push and pop ports.

anchors.name: n8_eb3
anchors.why: FIFO entry array written at write pointer, read at read pointer.

anchors.name: n10_24b
anchors.why: Write pointer addressing the array; increments on accepted push.

anchors.name: n6_59a
anchors.why: Read pointer selecting output entry; increments on accepted pop.

anchors.name: n7_d82
anchors.why: Occupancy count; derives full/empty flags and count output.

anchors.name: n13_74f
anchors.why: Push fire: write valid and not full; writes array, bumps pointer.

anchors.name: n9_41c
anchors.why: Pop fire: not empty and read ready; advances read pointer.

anchors.name: n11_5ef
anchors.why: Synchronous flush clearing both pointers and occupancy count.

anchors.name: n5_c1d
anchors.why: Write-side ready, high when FIFO not full.

anchors.name: n4_508
anchors.why: Write data stored into array on push.

anchors.name: n15_7b3
anchors.why: Read-side valid, high when FIFO not empty.

anchors.name: n0_a37
anchors.why: Read-side ready from consumer; enables pop.

anchors.name: n1_2b9
anchors.why: Read data: array entry at read pointer.

anchors.name: n14_2ad
anchors.why: Occupancy level output mirroring internal count.

groups.name: fifo_storage
groups.description: Eight-entry data array, write-addressed by write pointer, read combinationally.

groups.name: pointer_control
groups.description: Pointers, occupancy count, push/pop enables and flush logic.

groups.name: write_port
groups.description: Push valid/ready/data handshake; ready reflects not full.

groups.name: read_port
groups.description: Pop valid/ready/data handshake; valid reflects not empty; level output.
